verdict.rationale: USPTO documents that sign-in requires a USPTO.gov account with multifactor authentication plus a one-time identity verification. That verification can be completed online in under 15 minutes, with a paper alternative, so an authorized human can complete the path remotely without an in-person visit. However, the evidence never says what the online verification involves, so it cannot confirm the path avoids biometric or liveness checks. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific MFA methods and of the identity-verification mechanism (confirming no selfie or liveness step and no mailed PIN), and independent hands-on corroboration of the remote flow.
